lines.text: Many learners say: The film was very bored.
Better: The film was very boring.
A boring thing makes you bored.
Boring! This book is so boring.

data.why: A boring thing makes you bored.

native.tip: Фильм скучный — boring. Ты скучаешь — bored.
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “The film was very bored.”? 😅 Скучный фильм — “boring”. “Bored” — это ты сам скучаешь. Правильно: “The film was very boring.”. Послушай Карлос и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “boring”. Вещь — boring, человек — bored. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: A dull film is boring. You feel bored.
en.caption: Do you also say “The film was very bored.”? 😅 A dull film is “boring”. “Bored” is how you feel. Correct: “The film was very boring.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
